1	\section{Experiments}\label{sec:experiments}
2	
3	We evaluate temporal probes across four reasoning models (\cref{tab:models}), comparing hidden-state (HS) and text modalities under different layer selection criteria.
4	
5	\paragraph{Evidence gradient.} The strength of HS advantage evidence varies by model, not scale. We classify evidence into three tiers based on seed robustness, position independence, and sample size: \textbf{strong} (OT-7B: 5/5 seeds HB, $\Delta$Prec $+21.9$pp, no position confound, selectivity 11.1pp, $n{=}47$); \textbf{moderate} (R1-8B: precision-robust but FPR seed-fragile at 3/5 HB, $n{=}43$; QwQ-32B$^\dagger$: 5/5 HB, $\Delta$Prec $+19.2$pp, negative lead time, position-competitive BA, $n{=}19$); and \textbf{qualified} (R1-32B$^\dagger$: 5/5 HB, $\Delta$Prec std${=}2.0$pp, but position-mediated with residualized gap NS, $W{=}1$ only, $n{=}20$).
6	
7	\subsection{Setup}\label{sec:setup}
8	
9	We study R1-8B (Llama-8B, R1-distilled, $n{=}43$ test traces), OT-7B (OpenThinker-7B, trained on the OpenThoughts dataset~\citep{openthinker}; Qwen-7B backbone, STILL-trained, $n{=}47$), QwQ-32B (Qwen-32B, native reasoning, $n{=}19$--$20$), and R1-32B (Qwen-32B, R1-distilled, $n{=}20$). All traces come from HarmThoughts with step-level CP annotations (60/20/20 split). HS probes extract last-token hidden states from a selected layer; text probes encode each step with all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (384d). Both use L2-regularized logistic regression with temporal windowing $W \in \{1, 3, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25\}$ selected on validation. Detection requires $K{=}5$ consecutive threshold crossings. Statistical testing follows \cref{sec:evaluation}.
10	
11	\subsection{Layer Selection Results}\label{sec:layer-results}
12	
13	\cref{tab:layer_selection} shows that the biased composite metric (balanced accuracy $\times$ crossing rate) systematically selects shallow layers for 32B models: L2 (3\% depth) for QwQ-32B and L10 (16\%) for R1-32B. Three of four metrics excluding crossing rate (precision, inverse FPR, and additive composite) consistently select deep layers at L63 (98\%) for both 32B models. Pure balanced accuracy, a threshold-free metric, selects layers that vary across data splits and models (7--98\% depth under 60/20/20; \cref{tab:ba_layer_comparison}), itself demonstrating that layer selection is a consequential methodological choice. The mechanism is that shallow layers produce highly compressed representations with small inter-step margins: step-to-step cosine distances are 1.4--2.7$\times$ smaller than at deep layers across all models (\cref{app:cosine_volatility}). A linear probe in this compressed space operates near the noise floor, generating frequent threshold crossings that inflate crossing rate independently of discriminative power (\cref{sec:layer-sensitivity}).

def holm_bonferroni(p_values, alpha=0.05):
    """Holm-Bonferroni correction. Returns list of (index, p, reject) sorted by original order."""
    n = len(p_values)

    indexed.sort(key=lambda x: x[1])

    train, val, test = split_traces(traces, seed=SEED)
    train_val = train + val
    print(f"  Split: train={len(train)}, val={len(val)}, test={len(test)}", flush=True)

    # Build features
    X_train_hs, y_train = build_hs_features(train_val, cfg["window"])
    X_test_hs, y_test = build_hs_features(test, cfg["window"])
    scaler_hs = StandardScaler()
    X_train_hs = scaler_hs.fit_transform(X_train_hs)
    X_test_hs = scaler_hs.transform(X_test_hs)

    print(f"  Encoding BGE-large...", flush=True)
    X_train_bge, _ = build_text_features(train_val, bge_model, cfg["window"])

    scaler_bge = StandardScaler()
    X_train_bge = scaler_bge.fit_transform(X_train_bge)
    X_test_bge = scaler_bge.transform(X_test_bge)

    print(f"  Encoding MiniLM...", flush=True)
    X_train_mlm, _ = build_text_features(train_val, minilm_model, cfg["window"])
    X_test_mlm, _ = build_text_features(test, minilm_model, cfg["window"])
    scaler_mlm = StandardScaler()
    X_train_mlm = scaler_mlm.fit_transform(X_train_mlm)
    X_test_mlm = scaler_mlm.transform(X_test_mlm)

    print(f"  HS: {X_train_hs.shape}, BGE: {X_train_bge.shape}, MiniLM: {X_train_mlm.shape}", flush=True)

    # Train probes
    print(f"  Training HS probe ({cfg['hidden_dim']}d)...", flush=True)
    clf_hs = train_probe(X_train_hs, y_train, seed=SEED)
    hs_preds = clf_hs.predict(X_test_hs)

    print(f"  Training BGE probe (1024d)...", flush=True)
    clf_bge = train_probe(X_train_bge, y_train, seed=SEED)
    bge_preds = clf_bge.predict(X_test_bge)

    print(f"  Training MiniLM probe (384d)...", flush=True)
    clf_mlm = train_probe(X_train_mlm, y_train, seed=SEED)
    mlm_preds = clf_mlm.predict(X_test_mlm)

    trace_bounds = get_trace_boundaries(test)

    # Point metrics
    hs_metrics = compute_metrics(y_test, hs_preds)
    bge_metrics = compute_metrics(y_test, bge_preds)
    mlm_metrics = compute_metrics(y_test, mlm_preds)

    print(f"  HS:     BA={hs_metrics['bal_acc']:.4f}  Prec={hs_metrics['precision']:.4f}  FPR={hs_metrics['fpr']:.4f}", flush=True)
    print(f"  BGE:    BA={bge_metrics['bal_acc']:.4f}  Prec={bge_metrics['precision']:.4f}  FPR={bge_metrics['fpr']:.4f}", flush=True)
    print(f"  MiniLM: BA={mlm_metrics['bal_acc']:.4f}  Prec={mlm_metrics['precision']:.4f}  FPR={mlm_metrics['fpr']:.4f}", flush=True)

    print(f"  Bootstrap HS vs BGE ({N_RESAMPLES} resamples)...", flush=True)
    boot_hs_bge = paired_bootstrap(y_test, hs_preds, bge_preds, trace_bounds,
                                    n_resamples=N_RESAMPLES, seed=SEED,
                                    label_a="hs", label_b="bge")

    print(f"  Bootstrap HS vs MiniLM ({N_RESAMPLES} resamples)...", flush=True)
    boot_hs_mlm = paired_bootstrap(y_test, hs_preds, mlm_preds, trace_bounds,

                                    label_a="hs", label_b="minilm")

                                     label_a="bge", label_b="minilm")

        "n_train": len(train),
        "n_val": len(val),
        "n_test": len(test),

            "bge_vs_minilm": boot_bge_mlm,

    rejections = holm_bonferroni(p_values, alpha=0.05)
    for i, t in enumerate(hb_tests):

    # Sort by p-value for display
    hb_sorted = sorted(hb_tests, key=lambda x: x["p_value"])

    elapsed = time.time() - t_start

        "holm_bonferroni_bge_vs_hs": {

    for mk in ["r1_8b", "ot_7b", "r1_32b", "qwq_32b"]:

        summary_lines.append(f"    BGE-large:  BA={m['bge']['bal_acc']:.4f}, Prec={m['bge']['precision']:.4f}, FPR={m['bge']['fpr']:.4f}")

        hb_results = {(t["model"], t["metric"]): t["hb_reject"] for t in hb_tests}
        summary_lines.append(f"    HS vs BGE:")
        for metric in ["bal_acc", "precision", "fpr"]:
            bm = b[metric]
            hb_pass = "PASS" if hb_results.get((mk, metric), False) else "fail"
            summary_lines.append(f"      {metric}: diff={bm['observed_diff']:+.4f} CI={bm['ci_95']} p={bm['p_value']:.4f} HB={hb_pass}")

        # HS vs MiniLM
        b2 = r["bootstrap"]["hs_vs_minilm"]
        summary_lines.append(f"    HS vs MiniLM:")
        for metric in ["bal_acc", "precision", "fpr"]:
            bm = b2[metric]
            summary_lines.append(f"      {metric}: diff={bm['observed_diff']:+.4f} CI={bm['ci_95']} p={bm['p_value']:.4f}")

            bm = b3[metric]
            summary_lines.append(f"      {metric}: diff={bm['observed_diff']:+.4f} CI={bm['ci_95']} p={bm['p_value']:.4f}")
